# Java and Gradle

A shared bank feeds two fixed variants. Control source is omitted from the
student site and still supplies a public question to selected export.

The delivery has native PrairieLearn questions, public Java starter files and
private grader tests. Local Gradle tests execute the author reference and reject
the incomplete starter. Container execution and real PrairieLearn import require
separate verification. Attempts and pass criteria stay platform specific.

## Native delivery files

[Variant A descriptor](artifacts/variant-a/delivery.json),
[question info](artifacts/variant-a/questions/demo-java-gradle/exr-clamp/info.json),
[Java starter](artifacts/variant-a/questions/demo-java-gradle/exr-clamp/clientFilesQuestion/Clamp.java)
and [private checks](artifacts/variant-a/questions/demo-java-gradle/exr-clamp/tests/ClampChecks.java).

[Variant B descriptor](artifacts/variant-b/delivery.json) shows the separately
selected control question. These are instructor delivery artifacts for a demo;
full demonstration tests are deliberately public here.
